name: manual_9dd075
claim: launchctl bootstrap fails with 'Input/output error' when the label is marked disabled in launchctl print-disabled; run launchctl enable gui/<uid>/<label> first

decisions.notes: Cost hours of misdiagnosis on 2026-09-28: the com.syang.agentic-stack.paseo-guard plist was valid, plutil-clean, and its script ran correctly by hand, yet load and bootstrap both failed with exit 5. launchctl print-disabled showed the label as 'disabled' from an earlier launchctl unload. The failure mode is indistinguishable from a broken plist, and the job is silently absent rather than erroring.
